title: 2005 Kashmir earthquake
summary: A magnitude 7.6 earthquake struck Pakistan-administered Kashmir and Pakistan's North-West Frontier Province, also affecting India and Afghanistan. At least 79,000 people died and more than 32,000 buildings collapsed in Kashmir, leaving an estimated four million homeless. Poor construction worsened the toll, and aftershocks and landslides hampered relief.

where.historical_name: Pakistan-administered Kashmir and North-West Frontier Province
